subject: Commercial kickoff: contract origination, clause triage & signer journey
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acme.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Commercial kickoff: contract origination, clause triage & signer journey

Jordan —

Thanks for the intro call this morning. Per our discussion, I wanted to capture a quick intake so our contracts and legal teams can begin a focused redline pass. Goal is to get to a near-final MSA + Order Form within two weeks if procurement timelines allow.

As a starting point, can you confirm the following from Acme?
- Primary commercial contact for signature flow (name, title, email)
- Legal contact for redline negotiation (name/email)
- Billing address and PO requirements (does Acme require a PO for payment?)
- Any regulatory residency or data residency constraints (EU/GDPR, APAC hosting, etc.)

I've suggested a prioritized clause list below (we can reprioritize based on your needs):
1) Liability cap & carveouts (IP infringement / data breach carveouts)
2) Data residency & log retention periods
3) SLA / uptime and service credits
4) IP & ownership (model outputs / customer data)
5) Term, termination for convenience, and transition assistance

Attachments for our side: Redwood_MSA_v3 (master template we expect to start from). If you prefer to send your counterparty template, please attach.

Next steps:
- Jordan: share procurement/legal contacts and any internal procurement milestones (PO, payment schedule).
- Kimberly: will lead initial redline mapping once we have Acme's party sheet.
- I'll create a HubSpot deal and share a draft mutual action plan.

Best,
Neha Kapoor\Senior Manager, Commercial Operations\Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_v3 (referenced)

From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acme.io>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Legal <legal@acme.io>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial kickoff: contract origination, clause triage & signer journey

Neha —

Thanks for the note and the clear priorities. Quick responses inline and a bit of context from procurement: we generally require a PO for any contract over $50k and our billing team needs a 30-day net term; I will confirm whether we can do 30 or require 45.

Primary contacts:
- Commercial: Jordan Ellis, Sr. Product Partnerships (jordan.ellis@acme.io)
- Legal: Maya Rios (maya.rios@acme.io) — she is copied on this thread as part of the legal intake.
- Billing: Toni Vega (toni.vega@acme.io) — will be looped when we reach order form finalization.

Signers: Acme prefers a VP-level signature; exact signer depends on final SOW value — I'll confirm after procurement validates budget.

Flags from our side to prioritize:
- Please flag any non-standard IP language; Acme needs clarity on analytics outputs and whether Redwood claims model ownership.
- SLA: we need to see clear uptime targets and a Service Credit formula.
- Export controls / residency: we host in US and EU, but the initial deployment will be US only. If Redwood requires multi-region backups in EU, we need to agree on costs.

I've attached an account factsheet (Acme_Account_Info.xlsx) with billing address and initial PO contact.

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acme.io>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Draft redline priorities and handoff plan

Jordan / Neha —

Thanks Jordan — that factsheet helps. I've started a quick triage and attached two artifacts for Acme's review: 1) Redwood_MSA_v3_redline.pdf (first-pass with comments), and 2) exhibit-billing-draft.xlsx (billing/contact mapping).

High-level notes from our first pass (we'll expand if Acme pushes on any of these):
- Liability: will propose a mutual cap tied to annual spend (standard for commercial customers). Will note carveouts for gross negligence and IP infringement.
- Data residency: we can commit to US-only for initial deployment; EU residency will be a priced option listed in Exhibit B.
- SLA: propose 99.9% baseline with a tiered credit formula. Can tighten if enterprise SLA is required and budget permits.
- IP: Redwood to keep model IP; customer retains ownership of their data and trained artifacts. We can propose a license for outputs — willing to negotiate specific rights per use-case.

Operational ask: can Acme confirm expected seat count / concurrent user estimate or QPS so we can size order form line items? That will affect pricing and SLA targets.

I'll assign Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.com) from Legal to lead the formal redline discussions and track counterparty changes. Marissa — tagging you so you have context.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park\Director, Commercial Contracts\Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_v3_redline.pdf, exhibit-billing-draft.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Aug 2025 15:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial kickoff: contract origination, clause triage & signer journey (next steps)

All —

I'll take point on the redline thread. Plan:
- Today: review Kimberly's annotated MSA and prepare a clean comment summary for Acme legal (Maya).
- Wed (Aug 6): send tracked MSA with prioritized comments and a short rationale doc.
- Fri (Aug 8): target an internal sync to review Acme's counter if we receive it; otherwise we'll prepare a reconciling draft for procurement.

Action items assigned:
- Neha: please create the HubSpot deal and add the Acme factsheet (I used the link below).
- Kimberly: finalize any pricing exhibits and attach the order form draft.
- Jordan / Acme: confirm expected seat count or QPS and whether PO is required for this first year.

Useful links: https://redwood.hubspot.com/deal/ACME-6784 | DocuSign template: https://app.docusign.com/templates/12345

I'll escalate early if any non-standard IP requests appear.

Marissa Cole\Senior Counsel, Contracts\Redwood Inference
